div.div: سُكْحُوقٌ Tall; applied to a palm-tree; (S, O, K;) as also سَحُوقٌ: (S:) or tall and thin: (Lth, TA:) not known to Az on any other authority than that of Lth. (TA.) [J held the م in each of these words, as he says, to be augmentative; and has therefore mentioned them in art. سحق.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
